verdict: 28-day ROAS holds at 4.47x, but this week's trend needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads turned $1,412 in spend into $6,310 in revenue — a solid 4.47x return on ad spend overall. However, the most recent week showed a 34% drop in that return alongside an 18% decline in purchases, with the bulk of spend concentrated in one campaign that is showing reduced efficiency. Google Business Profile engagement also fell sharply in the last few days, which we're investigating now. Ad creative and campaign structure are being reviewed this week to stabilize efficiency heading into the next 7 days.
